source_limits: The leading-derivation and multiplicity techniques are classical. The original-ring specializations are reconstructed in the notes. The retained height-ten theorem is an additional working input only for the last profile consequence. No comprehensive statement-level novelty audit was completed.

scope_boundaries: All results assume actual original polynomial coordinates and a global slice. General coordinate entry is not proved.
The conical selected-adjoint result needs no degree bound on the last coordinate; the radial split assumes a quadratic last coordinate.

The initial-kernel comparison is restricted to q nonzero when speaking about the genuine leading initial of the last coordinate. Zero acceleration is handled separately by the retained nice-frame theorem.
The radial-mismatch branch leaves quadratic and cubic nonlinear cones unresolved; the resonant branch leaves height-eleven recognition unresolved.
Degree one sends the selected intrinsic kernel into A but does not automatically preserve that kernel. The commutator's coefficient on u need not vanish.
